meta.title: Task calendar
meta.description: Local task calendar, Pomodoro timer and review: task categories and colored cards, task lists, week/month/day calendar, urgent/important matrix, content-aware KISS retrospective, free-form reflections, a 48-cell daily time strip, subtask checklists, focus statistics, configurable day-view hours, and read-only macOS Calendar event sync. All data stays in local SQLite.
